temporal_notes: Collections occurred between December 2011 and June 2012, spanning end of dry season to beginning of rainy season.
source_text: Adult Anopheles mosquitoes were collected from six districts in Uganda; ... Jinja (Jn) in South central (0°26'N, 33°12'E)... Indoor resting, blood fed female adult Anopheles mosquitoes were collected from houses... Mosquito collections were carried out between December 2011 and June 2012... Results from PCR-species identification confirmed that the F0 adult females that oviposited F1 egg batches were all An. funestus in all locations apart from Masindi
